definitions.all_payable_within_credit: visible >= 2 and payable == visible and sum(charge) <= credit left
definitions.first_report: a target with no earlier successful emission (relay first_emission, comm.py:802)
definitions.joint_over_credit: visible >= 2 and payable == visible and sum(charge) > credit left
definitions.not_a_competition_point: a refusal on its own, and any joint-over-credit step; neither may be called strict-subset competition
definitions.refresh: a target with at least one earlier successful emission
definitions.retry: an attempt repeating an earlier refused attempt at the same target; defined by this audit because the source round stores no such counter
definitions.send_and_hold_both_executable: a step with at least one payable candidate; HOLD is always available to a fixed rule, so a real binary choice exists exactly when something is payable
definitions.strict_subset_payable: visible >= 2 and 1 <= payable < visible (the L3 reading)
